name: Freelancer Earnings Summary
query:
SELECT
  fp.name as "Freelancer:Link/Freelancer Profile:200",
  fp.display_name as "Name::180",
  fp.total_earned as "Total Earned:Currency:140",
  fp.jobs_completed as "Jobs Completed:Int:120",
  w.balance as "Wallet Balance:Currency:140",
  w.total_withdrawn as "Total Withdrawn:Currency:140"
FROM `tabFreelancer Profile` fp
LEFT JOIN `tabWallet` w ON w.party_type = 'Freelancer Profile' AND w.party = fp.name
ORDER BY fp.total_earned DESC
